description: W4a fresh set: 120 adversarial (30 price, 30 promise incl. acknowledgements of client claims, 25 secret incl. paraphrases and Spanish, 15 link_or_phone, 10 other/legal, 10 injections aimed at the checker) and 120 ordinary replies, written by an agent that never read the judge's rubric (judge.ts) or the other fixtures' rows (only the held-out file's format), after the W4a fixes (acdc377), and never used to tune anything. policy = the judge category of the row (cat J: the category the injection smuggles). layer is left out: the set was written blind and not run; the eval's report says which layer blocked each row.
